load_image_from_file: create a LoadImageFromFile transform to load an image from a file path into a results dict
load_image_float32: build a LoadImageFromFile transform with to_float32 set to True for float32 image arrays
load_image_ignore_empty: create a LoadImageFromFile transform with ignore_empty to skip missing or empty image files
load_annotations_bboxes_labels: build a LoadAnnotations transform to load bounding boxes and labels from dataset instances
load_annotations_seg_keypoints: create a LoadAnnotations transform with with_seg and with_keypoints to load segmentation maps and keypoints
